subtopic: Idempotency Keys and Distributed Request Retries
question_text: In an idempotent payment processing API, what race condition must the server guard against when two identical requests with the same Idempotency-Key arrive simultaneously?

options.text: Duplicate debit execution caused by concurrent cache misses before the first transaction completes and persists its result
HTTP 404 Not Found error returned to the client

answer_explanation: The server must use an atomic lock/reservation on the key (e.g. Redis `SET key in_progress NX EX 30` or SQL `INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`). Concurrent calls must wait or return HTTP 409 Conflict.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: The server must use an atomic lock/reservation on the key (e.g. Redis `SET key in_progress NX EX 30` or SQL `INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`). Concurrent calls must wait or return HTTP 409 Conflict.
